Legal dispute emerges in Ketan Agarwal murder case over representation

A legal dispute has arisen concerning the representation of Siya Goyal, an accused in the Ketan Agarwal murder case. Her lawyer, Ashutosh Srivastava, has sent a ₹10 crore defamation notice to her brother, Sahil Goyal, who denies engaging Srivastava. Another lawyer also claims to represent Siya Goyal, adding complexity to the case.
